text:
Jonah: Rainy weeknights — what's everyone's go-to wind-down 40–90min playlist or a short show/movie? quick poll: drop one music rec + one short show (<=4 eps) and vote with an emoji.
Maya: Music: 'Late Night Study' lo-fi mix. Show: Modern Love S1 ep2 — 30m, cozy. :heart:
Devin: Music: slowcore shuffle (Beach House, Low) or the 'slowcore' radio on Spotify. Show: Russian Doll ep1 is a great 25–30m starter. :thumbsup:
Rita: Music: 90s R&B slow jams playlist — perfect for winding down. Playlist link: `https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX3Ogo9pFvBkY` :headphones:
Lu: Short book rec if anyone's into tiny reads: The Ocean at the End of the Lane — small, weird, great bedside. :book:
Sam: Movie rec: Before Sunrise — ~100min, very low-stakes and cozy for rainy nights.
Jonah: Ambient/no-lyrics option? trying to cook without getting sucked into lyrics.
Devin: Ambient picks: Brian Eno — Music for Airports, or William Basinski — The Disintegration Loops (meditative). :ear_of_rice:
Rita: Also 'Rainy Day Coffeehouse' radio is a safe background mix. @SpotifyBot queue it?
SpotifyBot: Added 'Rainy Day Coffeehouse' to Jonah's queue. :robot_face:
Maya: Voting: music = :heart: (Late Night Study), show = :thumbsup: (Modern Love)
Sam: Voting: music = :clap: (90s R&B), show = :eyes: (Before Sunrise)
Lu: Voting: book = :book: (Ocean at the End of the Lane)
Jonah: Nice — tally so far: lo-fi / slowcore / 90s R&B; shows: Modern Love / Russian Doll / Before Sunrise; ambient picks too. I'll stitch a ~90min cooking/supper combo and drop it here later. :sparkles:
Maya: Please share the playlist! stealing for Sunday dinner. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Sam: 1-2 line notes pls otherwise i'll nap halfway thru :zzz:
Jonah: Will do — short descriptions + links when i post the combo. Thanks all for the recs! :raised_hands:
